source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 650 changes the repair test to wait for allMessagesLoaded, then display another folder and return. That checks settings restored from the rebuilt database rather than only a repaint of the existing view. The current test checks sort type, sort order and grouped state. Its assert_visible_columns helper checks membership in both directions, even though its documentation mentions order; it does not compare column positions. Proposed manual test rule: name and document the property actually asserted, and use an order comparison when order is the intended contract. These assertions were inspected, not executed.
title: Test persisted folder settings by leaving and returning
